description: Pause or resume one of the account’s own custom RSS sources, identified by source_id from list_sources. It only works on feeds added with add_source. To mute or unmute one of NewsJack’s built-in publications, use disable_global_source and enable_global_source, which take the publication name instead. Reversible and idempotent: setting the same value twice changes nothing. Pausing keeps the source configured; remove_source deletes it.

active.description: true to resume polling, false to pause it.

source_id.description: ID of a custom source, as returned by list_sources or add_source.

name: toggle_source
